نبذة

Sasha Beauty Salon, with its unique bouquet of services, is one of the first salons in the Emirates to offer a complete “Salon Spa” experience in U. A. E. Established in 1994, Sasha employs some of the best hairstylists and beauticians in the country. We pride in making your every experience as unique as you and we continually better our services to exceed your expectations. Our panoply of services include, but not limited to, Nail Extensions, Nail Art, Eyelash Extension, Hair Treatments/Colour, Facials, Waxing, Massages, Spa Manicures and Pedicures and Reflexology.
